name: smwmusic-aurora-borealis-catastrophe
title: Aurora Borealis Catastrophe
description:
As you go in to attack... and potentially free yourself from whatever nightmare you've gotten in this go round... it'll be quite a rollercoaster, to put things simply.

Yes, the song shown at Winter C3 2023 is now yours for the taking for your SMW ROM hacks. Enjoy. Just remember that this is for AddmusicK 1.0.9 and later due to a hot patch requirement.
